description: Custom ECL queries for MCH - Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin (LOINC 28539-5)
component_ecl: << 246093002 |Component (attribute)| = 38082009 |Hemoglobin (substance)|, << 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (<< 118535001 |Entitic mass (property) (qualifier value)| OR << 118532003 |Entitic substance amount (property) (qualifier value)|)
component_ecl_doc: The pool is the exact Component Hemoglobin with the entitic properties (mass per cell, substance amount per cell); the bare '<< Hemoglobin' pool would pull in HbA1c and the variants
_loinc_survey_doc: LOINC-side recall survey (Loinc.csv of the pinned LOINC release): regexes on COMPONENT / PROPERTY / SYSTEM that select the LOINC terms a laboratory physician would count as this analyte (CLASSTYPE 1, not DEPRECATED). The generator reports how many of them the LOINC Ontology pool reaches.

queries.name: Refined Query V2 (Entitic Mass Property)
queries.description: Uses Component = Hemoglobin AND Property = Entitic mass (118535001) AND Direct site = Erythrocyte specimen. Note: Entitic mass is NOT covered by the universal Measurement property, so this query specifically targets the Entitic mass property for MCH measurements.
queries.ecl: << 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : << 246093002 |Component (attribute)| = << 38082009 |Hemoglobin (substance)|, << 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = << 118535001 |Entitic mass (property) (qualifier value)|, << 704327008 |Direct site (attribute)| = << 119351004 |Erythrocyte specimen (specimen)|
